mapper.sql: SELECT 'OWNER_ACCOUNT' AS accountScope, k.wms_tenant_id AS wmsTenantId, wt.tenant_name AS wmsTenantName, k.erp_tenant_id AS erpTenantId, et.tenant_name AS erpTenantName, k.currency, COALESCE(r.recharge_amount, 0) AS rechargeAmount, COALESCE(c.charge_amount, 0) AS chargeAmount, COALESCE(r.recharge_amount, 0) - COALESCE(c.charge_amount, 0) AS balance, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.recharge_amount, 0) - COALESCE(c.charge_amount, 0) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS negative, COALESCE(p.pending_count, 0) AS pendingCount, NULLIF(GREATEST(COALESCE(r.last_time, '1000-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(c.last_time, '1000-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(p.last_time, '1000-01-01 00:00:00')), '1000-01-01 00:00:00') AS lastChangeTime FROM ( SELECT wms_tenant_id, erp_tenant_id, UPPER(currency) currency FROM wms_recharge_order WHERE account_scope='OWNER_ACCOUNT' AND status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED') UNION SELECT wms_tenant_id, erp_tenant_id, UPPER(currency) currency FROM wms_client_billing_record WHERE fee_type='SHIPPING' ) k LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wms_tenant_id, erp_tenant_id, UPPER(currency) currency, SUM(amount) recharge_amount, MAX(review_time) last_time FROM wms_recharge_order WHERE account_scope='OWNER_ACCOUNT' AND status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY wms_tenant_id, erp_tenant_id, UPPER(currency) ) r ON r.wms_tenant_id=k.wms_tenant_id AND r.erp_tenant_id=k.erp_tenant_id AND r.currency=k.currency LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wms_tenant_id, erp_tenant_id, UPPER(currency) currency, SUM(amount) charge_amount, MAX(create_time) last_time FROM wms_client_billing_record WHERE fee_type = 'SHIPPING' GROUP BY wms_tenant_id, erp_tenant_id, UPPER(currency) ) c ON c.wms_tenant_id=k.wms_tenant_id AND c.erp_tenant_id=k.erp_tenant_id AND c.currency=k.currency LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wms_tenant_id, erp_tenant_id, UPPER(currency) currency, COUNT(*) pending_count, MAX(create_time) last_time FROM wms_recharge_order WHERE account_scope='OWNER_ACCOUNT' AND status='PENDING' GROUP BY wms_tenant_id, erp_tenant_id, UPPER(currency) ) p ON p.wms_tenant_id=k.wms_tenant_id AND p.erp_tenant_id=k.erp_tenant_id AND p.currency=k.currency LEFT JOIN sys_tenant wt ON wt.id=k.wms_tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant et ON et.id=k.erp_tenant_id

SELECT 'PLATFORM_ACCOUNT' AS accountScope, k.wms_tenant_id AS wmsTenantId, wt.tenant_name AS wmsTenantName, NULL AS erpTenantId, NULL AS erpTenantName, k.currency, COALESCE(r.recharge_amount,0) AS rechargeAmount, COALESCE(c.charge_amount,0) AS chargeAmount, COALESCE(r.recharge_amount,0)-COALESCE(c.charge_amount,0) AS balance, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.recharge_amount,0)-COALESCE(c.charge_amount,0) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS negative, COALESCE(p.pending_count,0) AS pendingCount, NULLIF(GREATEST(COALESCE(r.last_time, '1000-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(c.last_time, '1000-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(p.last_time, '1000-01-01 00:00:00')), '1000-01-01 00:00:00') AS lastChangeTime FROM ( SELECT wms_tenant_id, UPPER(currency) currency FROM wms_recharge_order WHERE account_scope='PLATFORM_ACCOUNT' AND status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED') UNION SELECT wms_tenant_id, UPPER(currency) currency FROM wms_billing_record WHERE charge_status='POSTED' ) k LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wms_tenant_id, UPPER(currency) currency, SUM(amount) recharge_amount, MAX(review_time) last_time FROM wms_recharge_order WHERE account_scope='PLATFORM_ACCOUNT' AND status='APPROVED' GROUP BY wms_tenant_id, UPPER(currency) ) r ON r.wms_tenant_id=k.wms_tenant_id AND r.currency=k.currency LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wms_tenant_id, UPPER(currency) currency, SUM(amount) charge_amount, MAX(create_time) last_time FROM wms_billing_record WHERE charge_status='POSTED' GROUP BY wms_tenant_id, UPPER(currency) ) c ON c.wms_tenant_id=k.wms_tenant_id AND c.currency=k.currency LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wms_tenant_id, UPPER(currency) currency, COUNT(*) pending_count, MAX(create_time) last_time FROM wms_recharge_order WHERE account_scope='PLATFORM_ACCOUNT' AND status='PENDING' GROUP BY wms_tenant_id, UPPER(currency) ) p ON p.wms_tenant_id=k.wms_tenant_id AND p.currency=k.currency LEFT JOIN sys_tenant wt ON wt.id=k.wms_tenant_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN status='REVERSED' THEN 'REVERSAL' ELSE 'RECHARGE' END entryType, recharge_no businessNo, COALESCE(remark,'充值记录') description, CASE WHEN status='APPROVED' THEN amount ELSE 0 END amount, currency, status, voucher_file_id voucherFileId, COALESCE(review_time,create_time) occurredTime, COALESCE(reviewer_name,applicant_name) operatorName FROM wms_recharge_order WHERE account_scope='OWNER_ACCOUNT' AND wms_tenant_id=#{wmsTenantId} AND erp_tenant_id=#{erpTenantId} UNION ALL SELECT 'CHARGE', biz_id, COALESCE(product_name_snapshot,'物流产品费用'), -amount, currency, 'POSTED', NULL, create_time, NULL FROM wms_client_billing_record WHERE fee_type='SHIPPING' AND wms_tenant_id=#{wmsTenantId} AND erp_tenant_id=#{erpTenantId} ) x WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(x.currency)=UPPER(#{qo.currency}) AND x.occurredTime >= #{qo.startDate} AND x.occurredTime < DATE_ADD(#{qo.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY x.occurredTime DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN recharge_no LIKE 'CZC%' THEN 'REVERSAL' ELSE 'RECHARGE' END entryType, recharge_no businessNo, COALESCE(remark,'服务商充值') description, CASE WHEN recharge_no LIKE 'CZC%' THEN -amount ELSE amount END amount, currency, status, voucher_file_id voucherFileId, COALESCE(review_time,create_time) occurredTime, COALESCE(reviewer_name,applicant_name) operatorName FROM wms_recharge_order WHERE account_scope='PLATFORM_ACCOUNT' AND wms_tenant_id=#{wmsTenantId} AND status IN ('APPROVED','REVERSED') UNION ALL SELECT 'CHARGE', biz_id, COALESCE(fee_code,'平台服务费'), -amount, currency, charge_status, NULL, create_time, NULL FROM wms_billing_record WHERE charge_status='POSTED' AND wms_tenant_id=#{wmsTenantId} ) x WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(x.currency)=UPPER(#{qo.currency}) AND x.occurredTime >= #{qo.startDate} AND x.occurredTime < DATE_ADD(#{qo.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY x.occurredTime DESC
SELECT bill_month month, status FROM wms_monthly_bill WHERE wms_tenant_id=#{wmsTenantId} AND deleted=0 AND UPPER(currency)=UPPER(#{currency}) ORDER BY bill_month DESC, id DESC
